recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If the external IG registry search breaks again, fix or redirect the external registry site, or file a targeted issue for a specific core link, instead of broadly rewriting current core links based on the 2022 outage report.
issue_request: FHIR-37985 was a Published/Persuasive R5 technical correction reporting that entering any search criteria on the FHIR Implementation Guide Registry found no implementation guides, with a suggested short-term workaround of sending users directly to the FHIR Package Registry homepage.
initial_application: No source commit mentioning FHIR-37985 was found. The closest relevant application history is HL7/fhir#2401 / commit bc0c3d8207a, associated with FHIR-16526, which changed the active home page from an obsolete Confluence IG link to a curated IG-registry link plus a direct https://registry.fhir.org/ package-registry link and updated the shared navbar registry entries.
additional_context: source/index.html is active in publish.ini and now also includes https://packages2.fhir.org/xig as an all-IG index. tools/templates/newnavbar.html is the active shared navbar template; it keeps Implementation Guides and Artifact Registry as distinct entries. Live checks showed https://registry.fhir.org/guides redirects to the curated IG registry, while https://registry.fhir.org/ is the FHIR Package Registry homepage. The live curated IG registry currently loads 396 guides from fhir.github.io/ig-registry and simulated searches for common terms returned nonzero results. Confluence and Zulip searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Replacing all curated IG-registry links with the package-registry root would be broader than the Jira evidence now that the curated registry search works and the active home page already exposes the requested package-registry link.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-16526 drove HL7/fhir#2401, the homepage/nav registry-link update that provides the package-registry path relevant to this issue, but it is a separate home-page/menu tracker and was not decided here.
